changelog: Risk Calculator: the displayed 'Balance' and every dollar figure derived from it (risk $, position size, margin, available margin) were computed from balanceAtDayStart() -- a start-of-day balance that deliberately excludes today's own closed trades, introduced in v3.16.0 specifically to keep the risk-ladder TIER stable through the day. That start-of-day figure was also being reused as the trader-facing balance and the basis for every dollar amount, so a trade closing today never moved the calculator's numbers even though the sidebar (fed by the same challengeBalance(), just without the date filter) updated correctly. Root-caused with exact figures before any fix: start-of-day $9,418.04 minus today's real net P&L of -$53.34 equals $9,364.70-71, exactly the sidebar's own live balance, confirming the two screens were reading the same underlying data through two different WHERE clauses, not two different sources.

Fix: balanceAtDayStart() now feeds ONLY the ladder tier lookup (ladderTierForBalance(), and the tiers list's own is_current flag in getRiskStatus()) -- unchanged from before, and still the correct basis for that one purpose. Every dollar figure (risk_usd, position_usd, margin_usd, available_margin, room_usd, stops_to_fail) and the calculator's own displayed 'Balance' now come from the live challengeBalance($db, $challengeId) with no date filter -- the same call enrichChallenge() already makes for the sidebar. CalculatorController::autoRiskPreview() and ::getRiskStatus() both now return balance (live) alongside balance_at_day_start (tier basis only), and pages/calculator.php/js/calculator.js render both: 'Balance (current)' as the main figure, a small 'Start of day (tier basis)' line underneath so the ladder's own stability mechanism stays visible without being mistaken for the trader's actual balance.

Verified by hand against the reported figures (a live DB isn't reachable from this environment): with a $9,418.04 start-of-day balance and -$53.34 today, the live balance is $9,364.70/71 (a one-cent residual from re-deriving off already-rounded display figures, the same class of rounding gap documented elsewhere in this project's history -- the live controller computes both values fresh from the same unrounded SUM(net_pnl), so this residual does not occur in the running app). risk_usd at the 0.5% tier now computes as 0.5% of the live balance ($46.82) instead of 0.5% of the stale start-of-day figure ($47.09).
release_notes: No schema changes in this release -- nothing to migrate. Per instruction, nothing was deployed as part of this turn.
